shortDescription: NCL Various Post Answer Key 2026 out on 11 July for CBT on 6 July 2026 (HEMM Operator, Staff Nurse/Paramedical, Overseer).
content:
Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL) has released the answer key for CBT held on 6 July 2026 for HEMM Operator (Trainee), Paramedical Staff and Overseer (Civil) posts.

Key release: around 11 July 2026. Objection window till about 15 July 2026.

Download via candidate login on nclcil.in / linked exam portal.
